label: Peplink MAX Transit Duo Pro
description: Transportation router with two LTE-A modems: 1x GE WAN (convertible), 1x GE LAN, 1 Gbps throughput.
notes: Vendor figures from the Transit Duo Pro datasheet: Ethernet WAN port **1 / 0 (GE)**, LAN port **1 / 2 (GE)**, **Router Throughput 1 Gbps**, Wi-Fi AP Yes, PoE Input No. The Pro doubles the router ceiling of the standard Transit Duo (1 Gbps against 400 Mbps) on the same two-copper-port layout - the fastest member of the Transit family, and the one to pick when the bonded links are expected to actually aggregate.
